abstract_sentences.text: To accurately process a visual scene, observers must bind features together to represent individual objects.
This capacity is necessary, for instance, to distinguish an image containing a red square and a blue circle from an image containing a blue square and a red circle.

evidence.anchor: red square and a blue circle

abstract_sentences.text: Recent work has found that language models solve this ‘binding problem’ via a set of symbol-like, content-independent indices, but it is unclear whether similar mechanisms are employed by Vision Language Models (VLMs).

evidence.anchor: it is unclear whether similar mechanisms

abstract_sentences.text: This question is especially relevant, given the persistent failures of VLMs on tasks that require binding.
Here, we identify a previously unknown set of emergent symbolic mechanisms that support binding specifically in VLMs, via a content-independent, spatial indexing scheme.
Moreover, we find that binding errors, when they occur, can be traced directly to failures in these mechanisms.

Taken together, these results shed light on the mechanisms that support symbol-like processing in VLMs, and suggest possible avenues for reducing the number of binding failures exhibited by these models.

experimental_design.name: 研究问题与假设
experimental_design.description: Position IDs 是否存在；三类 heads 是否按阶段工作；coding 是否 relative；是否跨 image/task reuse；机制退化是否解释 binding error。

experimental_design.name: Scene description task
experimental_design.description: 图像含多个对象，prompt 描述部分对象，模型生成 missing object；成功需 parse、match、target selection 和 feature retrieval。

experimental_design.name: Synthetic scene dataset
experimental_design.description: 每个对象占 56×56 px、对应 2×2 个 28×28 patches；2×2/3×3 grid；每个 object identity × grid position 生成 K trials。PCA 另用 3×2、392×932 px、7,200 trials。

experimental_design.name: Relative/absolute grid design
experimental_design.description: 四种 2×2 sub-arrangement 放入 3×3 大网格，中心 object 保持相同 absolute location；RSA 和 patching 对比 relative/absolute。

experimental_design.name: PUG photorealistic design
experimental_design.description: PUG 生成有 3D、occlusion、lighting/shadows 的场景；两只 distinct-color animals，200 images，3 animals × 3 colors × 3 environments，保证 leftmost/rightmost。

experimental_design.name: Model coverage
experimental_design.description: 核心七个模型为 Qwen2.5-VL 3B/7B/32B、Qwen2-VL、LLaVA-1.5 7B/13B、LLaVA-OneVision-7B；Idefics2-8B 仅追加 RSA。

experimental_design.name: PCA/RSA protocol
experimental_design.description: PCA 用 last-token top-2 PCs；RSA 用 comma prompt tokens 与 last token，比较 residual-stream model RSM 和 position/feature target RSM。

evidence.anchor: projected on to the top 2 principal components

experimental_design.name: CMA protocol
experimental_design.description: clean c1、modified c2 和 patched c1*；prompt token patch 识别 ID retrieval，last-token patch 识别 ID selection/feature retrieval；每条件 50 samples 平均。

evidence.anchor: CMA scores are averaged across 50 samples

experimental_design.name: PUG intervention sweep
experimental_design.description: 用平均 position-ID prototypes，对三类 top-K heads 干预；feature retrieval heads 改 queries；α/K sweep 后主文取最佳参数。

experimental_design.name: RoPE-independent localization control
experimental_design.description: 在 RoPE 前对 object patch keys 做对称 ID swap，α=2，作用于 top-20 feature-retrieval-head layers。

experimental_design.name: Cross-task spatial reasoning
experimental_design.description: 先由 scene description 估计 ID，再注入 above/below/left/right spatial-relation task 的 top-100 ID-selection heads；两模型 ceiling。

evidence.anchor: assessing the extent to which position IDs are reused

experimental_design.name: Entropy/error design
experimental_design.description: 2×2 low entropy 为 2 colors × 2 shapes，high entropy 为 4 distinct conjunctions，均 1,600 total；3×3 每 condition 4,050 trials，shared vs unique conjunctions。

experimental_design.name: COCO extension
experimental_design.description: COCO 2017 validation；source/target 三个 random splits；从模型 open-ended enumeration 的前两个 objects 估计 ID，patch top 50/100/200 selection heads。

evidence.anchor: 3 random splits for the source and target sets

experimental_design.name: Counting extension
experimental_design.description: 3–8 unique objects，四种 shapes 与四种 colors，位置随机于 3×3；按三阶段每 head 最大 CMA score 排序，top/bottom-K output 置零。

experimental_design.name: Statistical quantities
experimental_design.description: PCA、Pearson RSA、CMA logits difference、accuracy/proportion correct/mean accuracy；无 pooled model effect。

experimental_design.name: Seeds, training budget, hardware and implementation
experimental_design.description: 仅 COCO 明确三次 random splits；训练 seed、训练预算、硬件、完整 inference hyperparameters 和当前代码版本未提供，复现声明称代码将 release。

evidence.anchor: Datasets, analysis and intervention code will be released

experimental_design.name: Independent baseline and uncertainty
experimental_design.description: 没有独立 baseline 表，也没有 error bars、confidence intervals、p-values 或多重比较细节；主要对照为条件、头排序和干预前后。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 论文把 multi-object visual binding 还原为 content-independent spatial indexing：ID retrieval heads 取 prompt object 的位置，ID selection heads 选 target，feature retrieval heads 取回 features；PCA/RSA、CMA、steering、key swap 与 entropy patch 依次连接表征、机制和错误（pp.3–10，Secs.3–4）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 scene-description 定义、三阶段架构、Qwen2-VL 阶段证据、CMA score/head layers、PUG >79% intervention、relative 方向、patch localization、spatial-reasoning reuse 和 entropy failure（pp.3–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 数据生成、RSA 数学定义、CMA 条件图、全模型 heatmaps、relative/absolute 全量结果、entropy 曲线、alpha/K sweep、COCO、counting 和 Table 1 后置；机制主线可读，但广度与 binding-error 数值复核需回看 Appendix（pp.11、14–32）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 在一张图中并列 architecture、PCA、RSA、CMA，随后用 position swap、feature swap、task transfer 和 high→low entropy patch 把抽象 ID 变成可操纵变量（pp.4–9）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 没有独立 theory/complexity guarantee；emergentness 的架构偏置与训练分布未拆分；模型级结果缺不确定性；relative 结论受 family 差异，COCO 使用模型派生 order，counting 只有单一 best model（pp.6、9–10、27–32）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 每个机制主张同时给出可命名的表征预测、局部 counterfactual intervention 和行为任务，并在相邻图表中显示方向一致性（pp.4–9）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于可访问 activation 且有明确对象/关系任务的 generative VLM；开放世界 grounding、无独立对象标签或不可 patch 的系统，需要另行验证 ID 的可识别性（pp.7、29–30）。
